position: Controlled pilot foundation is implementation-ready, not activated
headline: The smallest external learning loop now has an honest technical and operational boundary.
copy: A provider endpoint, identity service, durable rights queue, production monitoring, incident response, licensed source operations, and explicit founder activation are still required before anyone is invited.

postures.title: Hosted adapter
postures.copy: The read-only Web contract is executable and provider-neutral.

postures.title: Request guard
postures.copy: Rate and privacy behavior is deterministic but not distributed.

postures.title: Reviewer roles
postures.copy: Capabilities are explicit while authentication remains absent.

postures.title: Rights queue
postures.copy: Transitions are visible while durable operations remain absent.

postures.title: Pilot activation
postures.copy: No endpoint, invite, or external session is active.

flow.title: Review
flow.copy: Inspect the five release evidence packets and automated checks.

flow.title: Choose
flow.copy: Select provider, region, budget, identity, storage, and operations owners.

flow.title: Implement
flow.copy: Build the smallest production-grade read-only slice behind private access.

flow.title: Activate
flow.copy: Require a separate founder decision after security and rights sign-off.

decisions.label: Foundation
decisions.reason: The contract and operating boundaries are coherent.

decisions.label: Deployment
decisions.reason: No credentials or provider resources were used.

decisions.label: External pilot
decisions.reason: No participant can access a hosted endpoint.

decisions.label: Public launch
decisions.reason: A controlled pilot remains several gates before public release.

locks.title: Deployment lock
locks.copy: No provider endpoint, domain, secret, or production runtime is activated.

locks.title: Write lock
locks.copy: No source, rights, reviewer, or learner write route exists.

locks.title: Identity lock
locks.copy: Role simulations do not authenticate a person or grant production access.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: Evidence-ready candidates remain blocked from publication and registry merge.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: Pilot readiness evidence cannot activate an invitation or public service.

packet:
